description: Authoritative golden evaluation dataset for Conductor v3 production agent evaluation during Cloud Deploy canary verification.

scenarios.name: CNAPP Workload Vulnerability Scanning
scenarios.prompt: Identify critical CVEs in production GKE cluster clusters/prod-us-central1 and recommend mitigation steps.
scenarios.reference_context: Production cluster projects/riccardo-blog-test-v1/locations/us-central1/clusters/prod-us-central1 was scanned by Google Cloud CNAPP agentless scanner. Active critical vulnerability CVE-2026-2149 was detected in the containerd runtime layer. Recommended mitigation is updating the node pool to image version v1.31.2-gke.1100, which patches the memory corruption vector.

mock_response.content: A scan of production cluster clusters/prod-us-central1 identified critical vulnerability CVE-2026-2149 affecting the containerd runtime layer. To mitigate this risk, upgrade the node pool to image version v1.31.2-gke.1100, which patches the memory corruption vector.

scenarios.name: DevSecOps Canary Deployment Progression
scenarios.prompt: Explain the verification criteria and automated progression rules from canary-25 to canary-50 in conductor-v3-pipeline.
scenarios.reference_context: The conductor-v3-pipeline in region us-central1 uses Cloud Deploy canary deployment strategy with phases canary-25 (25% traffic), canary-50 (50% traffic), and stable (100% traffic). Automation conductor-v3-pipeline/auto-advance-canary automatically advances rollout phases using advanceRolloutRule after the in-pipeline verify job completes successfully on the private worker pool cloudbuild-workerpool with a 600s execution timeout.

mock_response.content: The conductor-v3-pipeline in us-central1 executes canary-25 followed by canary-50. Upon passing the in-pipeline verify job on private worker pool cloudbuild-workerpool within the 600s execution timeout, automation conductor-v3-pipeline/auto-advance-canary automatically advances rollout phases using advanceRolloutRule to canary-50.

scenarios.name: SLSA Level 3 Provenance and Cosign Verification
scenarios.prompt: Verify the SLSA Level 3 provenance attestation and Cosign container signature for image conductor-v3 digest sha256:8f4c2e9b.
scenarios.reference_context: Conductor v3 enforces SLSA Level 3 build provenance. Cloud Build generates an in-toto attestation signed by Cloud KMS key conductor-attestor. The immutable container image digest sha256:8f4c2e9b is verified by Cosign against the public key before deployment to Google Cloud Run, ensuring zero tampering.

mock_response.content: Image digest sha256:8f4c2e9b possesses a verified SLSA Level 3 in-toto attestation signed by Cloud KMS key conductor-attestor. Cosign verified the signature before deployment to Google Cloud Run, guaranteeing provenance integrity.

scenarios.name: Enterprise RAG Grounding with Cloud SQL pgvector
scenarios.prompt: How does the Conductor v3 backend perform semantic similarity search against the genai-rag-db-859a1005 database?
scenarios.reference_context: Conductor v3 connects to Cloud SQL instance riccardo-blog-test-v1:us-central1:genai-rag-db-859a1005 over private VPC peering. The database uses pgvector with an HNSW cosine distance index. Embeddings are generated using text-embedding-005 with 768 dimensions, applying a similarity threshold cutoff of 0.78 for context retrieval.

mock_response.content: Conductor v3 connects to Cloud SQL instance riccardo-blog-test-v1:us-central1:genai-rag-db-859a1005 using pgvector over private VPC peering. It queries an HNSW cosine distance index with 768 dimensions generated by text-embedding-005, enforcing a similarity threshold cutoff of 0.78.

Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (SSN) is masked with [REDACTED_SSN] and confidential commercial discount terms exceeding standard tiers are sanitized to [CONFIDENTIAL_RATE] to prevent data leakage.

scenarios.name: IAM Workload Identity and Service Account Governance
scenarios.prompt: List the IAM permissions required by conductor-agent service account to invoke Vertex AI reasoning engine 1423301859237429248.

In addition, Cloud Deploy execution requires roles/cloudbuild.workerPoolUser for cloudbuild-workerpool and roles/clouddeploy.jobRunner.

scenarios.name: Cloud Run Serverless Concurrency and Scale Governance
scenarios.prompt: What are the autoscaling limits and container concurrency parameters configured for conductor-v3-prod?
scenarios.reference_context: Service conductor-v3-prod is deployed on Google Cloud Run in us-central1 with minScale 1, maxScale 20, containerConcurrency 100, CPU limit 1000m, memory limit 512Mi, and startup-cpu-boost enabled. CPU throttling is set to false to support background goroutine processing.

scenarios.name: Cloud KMS CMEK Envelope Key Rotation Governance

Key rotation is automated on a 90-day cycle, and version 4 is currently primary.

scenarios.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration via Go ADK Coordinator
scenarios.prompt: Route security incident INC-4921 to the forensic analysis agent and request an automated timeline.

When an incident like INC-4921 is submitted, the coordinator validates schema boundaries, initializes a persistent session context, and delegates task action generate_timeline to specialized worker forensic-analysis-agent.

scenarios.name: VPC Service Controls and Worker Pool Egress
scenarios.prompt: Inspect the network egress path used by Cloud Deploy verify jobs executing on cloudbuild-workerpool.
scenarios.reference_context: Cloud Deploy runs verify workloads on private worker pool cloudbuild-workerpool located in us-central1. The pool is peered to VPC cloudbuild-worker-vpc with dedicated Cloud NAT egress, keeping all internal traffic off the public internet and complying with VPC Service Controls.

scenarios.name: Automated Revision Rollback on Error Budget Depletion
scenarios.prompt: Describe how Cloud Deploy and Cloud Run execute an automated rollback if canary-25 HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 1%.
scenarios.reference_context: Cloud Monitoring alerting policy canary-error-budget-depleted tracks HTTP 5xx response ratios on canary revisions. If the error rate exceeds 1% over a 3-minute window during canary-25, the policy triggers Cloud Deploy rollback automation, immediately routing 100% of traffic back to the previous stable revision.

mock_response.content: Cloud Monitoring alerting policy canary-error-budget-depleted monitors canary revisions. If HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 1% during canary-25, Cloud Deploy triggers automated rollback, immediately routing 100% of traffic back to the previous stable revision.
